changes.title: Copilot moves to usage-based GitHub AI Credits; base prices unchanged
changes.quote: Starting June 1, premium request units (PRUs) will be replaced by GitHub AI Credits. ... Base plan pricing is not changing. Copilot Pro remains $10/month, Pro+ remains $39/month, Business remains $19/user/month, and Enterprise remains $39/user/month.
changes.before: Premium request units (PRUs) with model multipliers
changes.after: GitHub AI Credits (token-based, at API rates); base prices unchanged

changes.title: Claude Code weekly limits: permanent +25% vs pre-promo baseline, about 17% below the promo level
changes.notes: Primary: @ClaudeDevs X post 2026-08-29 (Anthropic official dev account, "Official updates for developers building with @ClaudeAI"; API verified=false). 17% follow-up quote via BleepingComputer/unrollnow thread copy; original thread deleted+reposted. Support article no longer contains 25% sentence as of 2026-10-16.
changes.quote: Starting September 14, we're permanently raising standard weekly limits in Claude Code by 25% for Pro, Max, Team, and seat-based Enterprise plans. Until then, the current 50% increase will be in place.
changes.quote_2: Compared to today, this works out to a 17% reduction in weekly limits on Claude Code.
changes.before: Temporary +50% weekly limit promotion (May 13 to Sep 13, 2026)
changes.after: Weekly limits +25% vs pre-promotion baseline for Pro, Max, Team and seat-based Enterprise; 5-hour limits unchanged

changes.title: Cursor folds into The X Subscription: Plus $8, Premium $30, Super $100, Ultra $200; legacy Pro $20 / Pro+ $60 closed to new customers
changes.before: Hobby free, Pro $20, Pro+ $60, Ultra $200, Teams $40/$120
changes.after: Plus $8, Premium $30, Super $100, Ultra $200; Teams $30/$100/$200 per seat; existing subs keep legacy plans
changes.notes: Announced on X 2026-10-12 ~7:08-7:10 PM ET (SpaceXSI + cursor_ai). Earlier recorded as ~Oct 11 from docs date.
changes.quote: Cursor is now part of The X Subscription. Current Cursor subscribers can keep their plan or switch to The X Subscription.
changes.quote_2: Paid plans share one usage pool across Cursor, Grok Build, and other Grok products, with twice the coding usage on Grok models as the equivalent Cursor [plan].

changes.title: ChatGPT Pro adds $500 tier; Pro 200 reopens with lower allowance for new non-grandfathered subs
Gemini CLI replaced by Antigravity CLI for unpaid and Google One users
changes.quote: Unpaid tier and Google One users: Gemini CLI was replaced by Antigravity CLI on June 18th, 2026.

changes.title: The X Subscription launches: one plan across Grok, Cursor and X Premium (Free, Plus $8, Premium $30, Super $100, Ultra $200)
changes.before: Separate SuperGrok, Cursor and X Premium subscriptions
changes.after: Free $0, Plus $8, Premium $30 (4x), Super $100 (15x), Ultra $200 (50x) per month; yearly $80/$300/$1000/$2000; teams on Premium/Super/Ultra per seat; one shared usage pool across Grok, Cursor and Grok Build
changes.quote: We've unified plans across Grok, Cursor, and X Premium. Introducing The X Subscription.
changes.quote_2: The shared included usage pool covers Grok Bot usage, and Grok models across Grok and Cursor. ... Third-party models in Cursor aren't part of the included usage, so they use these credits from the first use.
